feeds.title: Peyton's Momma
feeds.description: Shanna is a single mom living in the suburbs of the Twin Cities raising an elementary age daughter. Shanna blogs about family/lifestyle/elementary age children topics. She likes to share tips and tricks she has discovered to help make her life run smoother.

feeds.title: Wit & Delight Blog
feeds.description: Kate lives in St. Paul, Minnesota with her extroverted husband, Joe Peters, son August, daughter Bennett, and their sweet English labrador, Winnie Bear. She is the founder of Wit and Delight. Wit and Delight is a home to professional feelings feelers, an elevator for glass ceiling breakers, and a soapbox for stories on anything from home decor and tile to battling anxiety and depression.

feeds.title: Thrifty Jinxy
feeds.description: HI I'm Chrysa. My blog,Thrifty Jinxy helps you live a fabulous life on a frugal budget. By spending less on the boring everyday stuff, you can have more money to splurge on the things you REALLY want, whether it's travel, fashion, tech - you name it! We feature money-saving tips, great on-line deals, recipes, product reviews, DIY ideas, tech, travel, pets, entertainment and more!

feeds.title: OneUniqueQueen
feeds.description: My name is Rose. I live in the Twin Cities, MN area with my wonderful husband of 17 years and a proud mama to a beautiful and amazing 13 year old daughter. I'm very active in the social media world and is currently accepting opportunities for family-friendly product reviews, giveaways, traveling, events and sponsorship's. I hope you enjoy and find my blog fun and informative!

feeds.title: Africa's Blog
feeds.description: I am Debbie ,a South African expat. Minnesota resident. I'm also a wife & Mom. Accountant by day, fearless Blogger by night. Cheetos & Mountain Dew enthusiast who believes stickers make the world a better place.

feeds.title: Real Housewives of Minnesota
feeds.description: Real Housewives of Minnesota is a lifestyle blog by Sarah, a mom from Minnesota. She writes about family life, recipes, fitness tips, parenting, and local adventures. Her posts are simple, friendly, and feel like advice from a friend. It's all about sharing real-life experiences and helpful ideas for busy moms.

feeds.title: Minnesota Momma Blog
feeds.description: Helpful tips for new moms about pregnancy, postpartum recovery, breastfeeding, baby-led weaning, newborn tips, parenting, and fitness. Jen is a Registered Nurse, owner of Minnesota Momma, and mom of two little ones. She loves to focus on topics that keep families happy and healthy.

feeds.title: MinneMama Adventures
feeds.description: A blog about discovering family friendly activities and everyday excursions for Minnesota parents and their minis. Authored by Nicki, who is an avid adventurer and mother of three.

feeds.title: Kelly Zugay
feeds.description: A Minnesota motherhood blog by Kelly Zugay, Founder of Made by Motherhood. Mom blog, motherhood blog, Minnesota blog.

feeds.title: Minnesota Millennial Mom
feeds.description: Hello! I'm Naomi Merrill, creator and owner of the Minnesota Millennial Mom blog. It feels really official to hold such a profound title. Especially when all I'm doing is sharing about #momlife with my fiercely independent toddler girl and hoping no one notices I haven't showered in three days.

feeds.title: You Matter by Megan May
feeds.description: You Matter by Megan May, offers authentic reflections on motherhood, mental health, personal growth, and faith. Each post is infused with warmth, vulnerability, and a genuine desire to uplift others.

feeds.title: Brandy Eckman
feeds.description: The Real Life Mom in Midlife' offers candid and relatable perspectives on the realities of parenting, aging, and marriage after 40.

feeds.title: Central Minnesota Mom
feeds.description: Karen is a 40 something Minnesotan who enjoys crafting, cooking, reading, fishing, gadgets, and family life. She works full-time and is going to school to become a family and consumer science (FACS) teacher. This blog focusses on product reviews, giveaways, crafts, recipes, technology, travel.

feeds.title: Twin Cities Family
feeds.description: Two working moms, founded Twin Cities Moms Blog in October of 2013 with hopes to provide a resource and bring the Twin Cities community of moms together through content, resources, social events, educational seminars and motherhood experience.

feeds.title: The Mama Report Blog
feeds.description: My name is Ali. I am a multi-tasker extraordinaire, a former high school history teacher, a fan of coffee, and a mom of three clever boys! We enjoy hiking and camping across the lovely state of Minnesota, as well as visiting other interesting sites and historic points across the nation.
